messages:
alex: quick async standup — what I did: finished eval pass for gptx-3-smallq on spanish promptset; fixed tokenization mismatch in pipeline. blockers: CI flagged 3 regressions (see jordan), need clarifications on expected top-k for reranker. today: iterate promptset + open PR for quant config. @samir can you take CR for the prompt changes later?

marie: noted re: tokenization. can you paste example failing case? I can update tokenizer tests.

jordan: CI report: 3 failing checks — semantic-similarity drop on prompt id 44, answer truncation on longctx tests, and one diff in reranker top-1. link: https://ci.redwood-infra/internal/12345 . logs show model output cut at 2048 tokens in 2 runs.

dev-bot: build #2245 finished with status FAILED — tests/regression/evals (details: https://ci.redwood-infra/internal/12345)

alex: pasted failing case below:
```
input: "¿Cuál es la capital de Argentina?"
expected: "Buenos Aires"
model: "[truncated] Buenos"
```
Probably KV warmup issue when switching to longctx. cc @jordan

samir: I can take the CR after lunch. also suggest adding a small smoke that runs longctx warmup with prefix cache.

marie: quick eval command if useful:
`./scripts/run_eval.sh --model gptx-3-smallq --prompts promptset/es-short.json --save ./out.json`

jordan: re: reranker top-k — I think we set k=5 in config v2, but rollout used k=3. that mismatch could explain score shifts.

alex: thanks — I'll pin k=5 in the PR and add the tokenizer test. moving the failing examples to docs/regressions/ so QA can see.

samir: noted, I'll review PR #412 after lunch. :thumbsup:

marie: leaving a small note: if we bump kv cache size, watch memory on dedicated nodes (seen OOM at +20%).

alex: good catch — will add a canary flag for kv cache size. end of my update. :rocket:
